name: UNIQUE_ID
description: Unique record code generated by system. Primary Key for Person table.

name: COLLISION_ID
description: Crash identification code. Foreign Key, matches unique_id from the Crash table.

name: CRASH_DATE
description: Occurrence date of collision

name: CRASH_TIME
description: Occurrence time of collision

name: PERSON_ID
description: Person identification code assigned by system

name: PERSON_TYPE
description: Bicyclist, Motor Vehicle Occupant, Pedestrian,

name: PERSON_INJURY
description: Injured, killed, unspecified

name: VEHICLE_ID
description: Unique vehicle record associated with person. Foreign Key to the vehicle table

name: PERSON_AGE
description: Automatically calculated based on date of birth

name: EJECTION
description: Indicates the following: Not ejected, partially ejected, or ejected from the vehicle

name: EMOTIONAL_STATUS
description: Apparent death, unconscious, semiconscious, etc.

name: BODILY_INJURY
description: Injured body area (i.e. head, face, neck, etc.)

name: POSITION_IN_VEHICLE
description: Seating position #1-#8 (i.e. driver, front passenger, etc.)

name: SAFETY_EQUIPMENT
description: Safety equipment being used (i.e. lap belt, harness, child restraint, air bag, etc.)

name: PED_LOCATION
description: Location of the pedestrian (i.e. at intersection, not at intersection)

name: PED_ACTION
description: What the pedestrian was doing at time of crash (i.e., walking with the signal, against the signal, etc.)

name: COMPLAINT
description: Type of physical complaint (ex. Concussion, severe burn, severe bleeding, etc.)

name: PED_ROLE
description: Pedestrian, witness, in-line skater, other, etc.

name: CONTRIBUTING_FACTOR_1
description: Factors contributing to the collision for designated vehicle

name: CONTRIBUTING_FACTOR_2
description: Factors contributing to the collision for designated vehicle

name: PERSON_SEX
description: Gender of person
